title: Ghost in the Machine v4.1 — direct replication of the v4 authorship campaign (Study A of the v5 follow-up)
author: Kai Piper
scientific_status: Synthetic computational experiment. No hypothesis below concerns, measures or can establish phenomenal consciousness.
question: Does a closed-loop self/world-modelling agent contain a macroscopic self-variable whose dynamics (E) are causally emergent, (A) depend on the agent authoring its own actions, and (S) are specific to the self population, to a comparator mechanism, and to structure that survives a calibrated null ladder?

development_phase.note: None. Code and analysis are the frozen v4 files (hashes in the v5 lock), unchanged. Only seeds and worlds are new.

common.agent_defaults: ghost_v4.engine.AgentConfig defaults: 120 nodes, 16 observation dims, 7 actions, radius 1.0 (no gain ramp), leak 0.5, temperature 0.18

design.yoking: Cross-yoking within a world block: network s (same weights, same world) is run once closed-loop and once as a twin receiving the recorded observation stream and executed actions of the next network in its block (cyclic). The twin still forms intentions, sends efference copies and learns; its intentions no longer cause what it senses.
design.placebo: Each full master is re-run with different world noise and action-sampling noise (replicate = 1): an A/A contrast with no authorship difference, used to check that the paired contrast pipeline is calibrated.

endpoints.self_persistence: I(V_t; V_t+1), V = maximum-autocorrelation linear feature of the self population, Gaussian estimator (nats).
endpoints.self_psi: Rosas et al. (2020) Psi for the same V against the self population's nodes as parts.
endpoints.atlas_persistence_<population>: the same persistence quantity for each of the 12 populations.
endpoints.phi_r_mean: Mean pairwise Phi_R (Mediano et al. 2022) across the 66 pairs of population mean-fields.
endpoints.irr_nodes: Mean over all 120 nodes of the ordinal-pattern (order 3) KL time-irreversibility.
endpoints.te_net_to_obs: Gaussian transfer entropy from the top-5 network PCs to the top-4 observation PCs, conditioned on 10 steps of observation history.

gate.name: manipulation check: authorship is real
gate.test: te_net_to_obs(master/full) > te_net_to_obs(twin/full), paired sign-flip test, one-sided, alpha 0.05
gate.consequence: If M fails, H1-H7 authorship contrasts are uninterpretable and the verdict is level 0.

primary_family.name: the authorship effect is self-specific
primary_family.contrast: (persistence_self master-twin) - mean over the 11 other populations of (persistence_p master-twin)

primary_family.name: the authorship effect depends on the comparator
authorship increases causal emergence of the self (ghost conjecture)
the network's arrow of time is nonlinear
primary_family.contrast: per-seed z of irr_nodes(master/full) against 49 multivariate phase-randomized (L2) surrogates

primary_family.name: authorship increases the arrow of time

test: Exact/Monte-Carlo paired sign-flip randomization test on the mean (20000 flips), one-sided in the stated direction.
multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over H1-H7 (family-wise error rate 0.05). The gate M is tested separately.
effect_sizes: mean paired difference with 95% percentile bootstrap CI, Cohen's d_z and Hedges' g_z.

verdict_levels.0: No authorship effect on the self (or manipulation check failed).
verdict_levels.1: Authorship effect: the self's slowest mode is more persistent when the agent authors its actions (M and H1).
verdict_levels.3: Self-specific, comparator-dependent authorship effect (M, H1, H2, H3): a self-stabilization mechanism.
verdict_levels.4: GHOST-v4: level 3 plus authorship-dependent causal emergence of the self (H4). An operational label for a conjunction of synthetic results, not a claim about experience.

success_criterion: The v4 verdict (level 4) replicates if the replication also reaches level 4. Each hypothesis is reported individually whatever the verdict.
